title: Runtime Harness: Meta-tests (must-have P1-P3, F1-F2 + stretch suites)
description:
Implement runtime harness meta-tests from docs/plans/16-runtime-test-harness-test-harness.md.

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

Key deliverables (must-have):
- P1: Workload generator validity (profile constraints, mode ratio ±1, concurrency caps)
- P2: Metrics aggregation conservation (aggregated = sum of per-session)
- P3: Baseline comparison determinism (identical verdicts across N>=100 runs)
- F1: Telemetry loss bursts (graceful degrade, data-quality flags)
- F2: Clock skew simulation (timeline normalization, robust percentiles)

Stretch deliverables:
- P4-P5, F3-F5, O1-O3, S1-S3, B1-B4, ST1-ST3, SEC1-SEC4

CI tiers: PR-fast ~10m (must-have), Nightly ~1h (all), Weekly ~24h (stress/soak)

Depends on: Runtime harness core task.
